symptom: `describe microflow` renders a loop with an **empty body** — `loop $X in $L begin end loop;` — when the body carries an `@annotation`. Silent, exit 0, and the truncated script passes `check`, so the documented describe → exec round trip **deletes the loop body**. `bson dump` and `--format mermaid` both still show the activity
cause: `emitLoopBody` picks the body's start as "no incoming sequence flow, leftmost then topmost" (`preferLoopBodyStart`). A `*microflows.Annotation` **is** an object in `ObjectCollection.Objects` but connects via `AnnotationFlows`, never `Flows`, so its incoming count is permanently 0 and it was always a start candidate. When it won, traversal began at a node with no outgoing sequence flow and emitted nothing. Only loops: the top level starts from its `StartEvent`, and mermaid iterates objects directly rather than traversing
insight: **The defect is positional, and that is the trap**: annotation LEFT / ABOVE-same-X / ABOVE-LEFT lose the body, annotation RIGHT renders correctly *including* the annotation — so a fixture that puts it on the right passes against broken code. Cover all four. **Not Studio Pro-only**, which was the first wrong reading: mxcli's own builder emits the annotation at the same X and above (measured activity (150,80), annotation (150,-20)), the losing shape, so mxcli destroyed loop bodies it authored itself. **Why #330 missed it**: that fixture covers the same construct, but its Go regression tests the AST→BSON *build* path and its describe assertion is a manual procedure in a comment — `make check-mdl` runs without a project, so CI only syntax-checked it. Nothing had ever *described* an annotated loop body. The durable guard is a **build → describe round trip** using the builder's real positions, asserting its own premise so it fails loudly if layout changes stop it exercising the defect. Not expressible as `.fail.mdl` (the MDL is valid; the bug was in describe). Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/965-loop-body-lost-to-annotation.mdl`, guards `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_describe_loop_annotation_test.go`. Issue #965
